intro: Following a perilous excursion to an Ashenvale moonwell, a phial of sanctified waters must be ferried south to Freewind Post. The tauren mystic Rau Cliffrunner needs this lunar essence to breach an eternal flame warding an ancient centaur relic in Thousand Needles.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.
I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
